description:
A music player that respects what's yours.

Noctis is a desktop music player for your local library — fast browsing,
synced lyrics, metadata editing, EQ, and more.
Discord
Download
Pick your platform from the Assets below:
────────┬──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Platform│Files
────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Windows │Noctis-v1.4.4-Setup.exe (installer) · Noctis-windows-x64.zip (portable)
────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
macOS   │Noctis-osx-arm64.dmg (Apple Silicon) · Noctis-osx-x64.dmg (Intel)
────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Linux   │Noctis-x86_64.AppImage · Noctis-linux-x64.tar.gz ·
        │Noctis-linux-arm64.tar.gz
────────┴──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
> Running on macOS — the app isn't code-signed, so Gatekeeper quarantines it on first launch. After dragging Noctis into your Applications folder, clear the flag once in Terminal:
>
> xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Noctis.app
>
> Then open Noctis normally.
What's Changed
Fixed
- Fixed Add to Playlist artwork flicker
- Fixed can't click Home from album detail
- Fixed Linux updates not working for tar.gz installs
- Fixed two Noctis instances opening on Linux/macOS
- Fixed mini player lyrics color band overhang
- Fixed mini player lyrics lines cut off at top
- Fixed mini player shake when opening drawers
- Fixed mini player forgetting size after closing Lyrics
- Fixed marquee stutter on multiple surfaces
- Fixed engine transition buzz (buffer clearing bug)
- Fixed butt-splice clicks at track cuts
- Fixed seek skip/pause lag
- Fixed Search failed message misleading on NetEase
- Fixed NetEase encrypted response handling
- Fixed resume seeking to wrong position
- Fixed ReplayGain volume too low
Added
- Added true-gapless splice engine (Windows, default on)
- Added Favorite artists (sort to top, persist)
- Added user-configurable album cover sizing
- Added Lyrics pane backdrop effects (color mode, mesh blobs)
Improved
- Improved mini player transparency
- Improved mini player canonical sizes (Bar, Lyrics)
- Improved mini player time label visibility
- Improved marquee wrap-around with rest period
- Improved lyrics font scaling with window size
- Improved search error messages (provider-specific)
- Improved album grid column calculation for ultrawide
Full Changelog: v1.4.3...v1.4.4
